scoring_justification: Phonon energies compared to paper reference values (T0). TDS intensity structural ordering (S > Y) and positivity checked (T3); full T1 recompute from raw DFPT eigenvectors is infeasible within solver's output artifacts.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference phonon energies at Gamma, Y, S points from the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Sec. III: Y point optical phonon 9.3 meV, S point 4.8 meV from IXS/DFPT. Gamma point DFPT value 1.0 meV (soft mode).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper text and the reference solver solve.sh which encodes the correct DFPT result.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper-reported or DFPT-consistent phonon energies at the selected Brillouin zone points.

schema.description: Lowest optical phonon energies at Gamma, Y, S.

outputs.description: Lowest optical phonon energies at Gamma, Y, and S points.

schema.description: One-phonon TDS intensity at Y and S points at 300 K.

outputs.description: One-phonon TDS intensity at Y and S points at 300 K. The checker will verify the rows are present and the intensities are positive, with a hidden structural condition.

output_contract.notes: TDS intensity values are in arbitrary units.

steps.description: Check that Gamma, Y, S phonon energies are positive and within tolerances of paper reference values.
Verify TDS intensity rows for Y and S at 300 K exist, are positive, and satisfy S > Y ordering.
